task.description: Implement ADP-02 in backend code and migrations per the design artifact src/design/adp-02-tenant-columns-definition-instance-audit.md. Add additive tenant_id columns and supporting indexes/constraints to definition, instance, task, transition, and audit persistence tables without destructive changes. Update repository/store/query paths to enforce tenant scoping and preserve deterministic default-tenant behavior for legacy requests lacking explicit tenant context. Ensure cross-tenant reads/writes are blocked by query predicates and uniqueness/index strategy as designed. Add or update unit/integration tests necessary to validate ADP-02 acceptance and regressions for PD-01, PD-07, EE-01, and OBS-03 interactions under tenant scoping.
acceptance_criteria: Migration(s) apply cleanly and add tenant_id schema/index changes for ADP-02 scope
Backend persistence/query paths enforce tenant scoping with default-tenant compatibility
No cross-tenant leakage in definition, instance, task, transition, or audit access paths

result.summary: Implemented ADP-02 tenant scoping across definition, instance, and audit persistence with additive schema/index migration, default-tenant compatibility, and integration coverage.
